ruleSummary: Derive the original case denominator exactly from the denominators of all admitted fixed shares in the case.
conditions: All fiqh eligibility and fixed-share decisions have already been made by admitted production rules.
Use exact integer least-common-multiple arithmetic over the fixed-share denominators.
exclusions: This technical rule does not decide heir eligibility, blocking, fixed shares, residue, awl, radd, or correction.
A denominator outside the source-listed origins is not admitted by this atom.
blockingAndPriorityInteractions: Run after admitted fixed shares are assigned and before awl or tashih.
The no-fixed-share residuary identity base of 1 is arithmetic infrastructure, not an additional source-listed fixed-share origin.
